title: My New Skincare Protocol (2025): Bryan Johnson's daily routine, supplements and skin-age tracking
summary: Bryan Johnson explains how he rebuilt skin he damaged before 40, improving skin age from an average of 64 to between 37 and 42. He lays out lifestyle basics, a daily topical routine with active ingredients, supportive supplements, pro tips and how he measures skin age with multispectral imaging.

principles.text: Healthy skin starts with exercise, sleep and a Blueprint-like diet; avoid junk food, cigarettes and vaping.
Get the right amount of sun and protect skin during high UV hours with clothing, a hat, UV umbrella and mineral sunscreen.
principles.quote: The sun is good for you but not too much and not too little. Just the right amount will do.

principles.text: Daily routine: face wash morning and night, mineral sunscreen, and moisturizer for body and face.
Use targeted actives: niacinamide morning and night, vitamin C in the morning, hyaluronic acid as desired, and prescription tretinoin at night.
Support skin with collagen (20-30g daily) paired with vitamin C, plus niacinamide and hyaluronic acid.
principles.quote: Collagen (20-30g daily): Pair with Vitamin C to boost collagen synthesis

principles.text: Track skin biological age with multispectral imaging (such as Visia) covering UV damage, pore size and dark spots.
principles.quote: To track my progress, we routinely measure the biological age of my skin using multispectral imaging
